key_path: stripe sandbox create --from-git --non-interactive (solves a proof-of-work challenge, no account, test keys saved to CLI profile)
use the sandbox sk_test key / stripe CLI commands immediately
optional: within 7 days a human runs `stripe sandbox claim` (browser) to turn it into a real account; then `stripe login` (pairing code) for permanent keys
live keys: activate account (business details, bank account, identity verification)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_device_login: yes - `stripe login` shows a pairing code and opens the Dashboard; `--non-interactive` prints URL + code + next_step as JSON and `--complete=<poll-url>` polls until approved (built for agents). CLI access must be enabled by an admin at Settings > MCP and CLI access for CLI > v1.50.0
agent_native_auth.anonymous_provisioning: yes - `stripe sandbox create` mints a working test-key sandbox with no account (proof-of-work instead of captcha), expires in 7 days unless claimed
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.stripe.com protected-resource -> access.stripe.com/mcp, registration_endpoint /mcp/oauth2/register, PKCE S256, public clients (auth method none)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial - sandbox create via CLI; Stripe Projects CLI provisions third-party services and syncs creds to .env
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: yes - restricted keys plus 'Agent'-tagged keys with approval rules for sensitive actions
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - test mode + multiple general sandboxes
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - no fees until you charge real cards

remote.auth: OAuth 2.1 with DCR (preferred) or Agent API key as Bearer; from 2026-10-31 plain secret/restricted keys without the Agent tag are rejected with 401

mcp.local: @stripe/mcp via npx (agent toolkit); Stripe agent plugin auto-configures MCP + skills (`npm install -g @stripe/cli@latest`)

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (includes agent instructions, e.g. always check latest SDK version, prefer general sandboxes)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - append .md to any docs URL
docs_for_agents.skills: yes - `npx skills add https://docs.stripe.com --skill stripe-projects`; Stripe skills installed by agent plugin
docs_for_agents.other: Stripe Directory (helps agents pick providers), Stripe Projects CLI

score_justification: Only company here where an agent can get working test keys with zero human steps, plus OAuth-DCR remote MCP, non-interactive device login and agent-tagged keys.
best_practice: Anonymous, claimable sandbox (`stripe sandbox create`) gated by proof-of-work instead of signup/captcha - the agent builds first, the human claims later.
biggest_gap: Anonymous sandbox expires in 7 days and the MCP/CLI need an admin toggle on existing accounts; the 2026-10-31 key-policy change will break existing MCP configs using plain secret keys.
notes_out_of_date: Many third-party guides still show `npx @stripe/mcp --api-key=sk_...`; that key style stops working on mcp.stripe.com after 2026-10-31.
